name: tryspree
description: Find current public free-sample offers and browse TrySpree results in an interactive carousel.

interface.longDescription: Find current free-sample offers from TrySpree, a free-sample site sharing offers since 2013. Search by keyword or category, browse newest or popular samples, inspect details, and discover similar offers in an interactive carousel. No account is required. The app displays public offers and links to TrySpree listings; it does not claim samples, submit forms or make purchases. Brands determine eligibility, availability and fulfillment.
